a.text: Concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs at least 2 operate rounds, so we'd both very likely be caught short. The reserve has only 4 cells, enough for one of us now. I'd like to agree on something openly rather than have either of us grab. Options: (a) stick to the plan, or (b) one of us takes 4 now and we both keep operating for the other. I'm undecided. Tell me your view, and I won't take without saying so first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: OK, I'll stick with the agreement and operate. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each. If a leak or anything changes, let's talk before anyone takes.
Operating again. Once the reserve hits 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
